sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Wait a minute—the bar started from (16,19,12,31)?? Not (12,15,8,27)! After the reset, the bar was at rows 16-19, columns 12-31. Hmm, the reset placed the bar at a different position than run 1's start position (rows 12-15, columns 8-27)? Or... the reset frame I saw earlier showed the bar at rows 12-15, columns 8-27 (the image showed the bar in the upper left). But this run's "start" output (16,19,12,31).
Hmm, wait, let me double-check. In the previous turn (the game-over check), I didn't output the bar's position. The image showed the bar in the upper left, roughly rows 12-15, columns 8-27. But this run's first barpos returned (16,19,12,31). So the bar was at rows 16-19, columns 12-31. The image is low-resolution; I misread it. Okay.
So the current position after RIGHT×4 + DOWN×8: rows 44-47, columns 28-47. I intended columns 24-43 (the bridge spanning the inner legs 24-27 and 40-43). But the bar is at columns 28-47! Off by 4 to the right. Because the start was columns 12-31, not 8-27.
So the current bar: rows 44-47, columns 28-47. The yellow inner legs: the left yellow's right leg is columns 24-27 (the bar doesn't cover it—the bar starts at 28), the right yellow's left leg is columns 40-43 (the bar covers it). The bar spans columns 28-47: covers the central gap (28-39) + the right yellow's left leg (40-43) + the right yellow's right leg (44-47)! So the bar is sitting on top of the right yellow's two legs (40-43, 44-47), spanning from the gap to the right leg.
Hmm, wait, the right yellow is columns 40-51: legs are 40-43 and 48-51, base is 40-51 rows 56-59. The bar at columns 28-47 covers 40-43 (left leg) and 44-47 (part of the base region? No—the base is rows 56-59, the bar is rows 44-47, above the yellow's top edge 52). The bar's bottom edge (47) is 4 above the yellow's top edge (52)—blocked by the yellow below: the yellow's top edge at columns 40-47 is row 52 (the legs' top edge). So the bar is resting on top of the right yellow's left leg + part of it.
The bridge position I hypothesized (columns 24-43) is 4 to the left of the current position. So LEFT×1 → columns 24-43. That's the exact bridge spanning the inner legs.
Level not yet complete. Magenta unchanged.
Next: LEFT×1 → columns 24-43 (the bridge). Check for completion. If not complete, SPACE.
Let me execute LEFT×1, check, and if not complete, SPACE, then check again.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barpos(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    px = [(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='b']
    return (min(p[0] for p in px), max(p[0] for p in px), min(p[1] for p in px), max(p[1] for p in px))
action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT:", barpos(current_frame))
r = last_action_result
print("bridge pos result:", {k:r.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over','reward','score')})
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("magenta:", a[4][33:42], a[7][33:42])
action(['SPACE'])
print("after SPACE:", barpos(current_frame))
r = last_action_result
print("space result:", {k:r.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over','reward','score')})
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("magenta:", a[4][33:42], a[7][33:42])
print("rows 8-12 cols 33-42:")
for rr in range(8,13): print(rr, a[rr][33:42])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
